Priya (People Ops): Hey team — I need to update my homebase from OR -> WA and move in mid-April. Quick checklist: do I need to notify payroll/benefits separately? Is the WFH stipend prorated if I switch states mid-month? Any state nexus concerns I should raise now?
Miguel (Payroll): Hi @Priya — yes please submit the homebase change form so payroll can update withholding. Stipend is prorated by calendar days in the month (we do day-level proration).
Priya (People Ops): Got it, thanks. If I sign lease on Apr 10, what payroll month will reflect WA withholding?
Miguel (Payroll): If we get the form + lease copy by Apr 1 we can change for the Apr payroll cycle; otherwise changes apply in the following pay period (May). Worst case you'll see OR withholding for Apr and WA for May.
Jamie (Eng): Do you also need to update benefits address? I swapped states once — some carriers require address update or a local broker review.
Ava (People Ops): @Priya — yeah update your address in Workday/Benefits portal, and ping People Ops benefits so we can check carrier eligibility. If the move changes your primary care network, enrollment adjustments may be needed.
Priya (People Ops): Any implications for office access (satellite office or badge)?
Ava (People Ops): If you plan to switch your primary office hub, submit the Badge/Workspace request. Moving homebase doesn't auto-revoke access but we may reassign nearest hub for desk booking.
Priya (People Ops): Concerned about tax nexus for Redwood — could my move create employer obligations in WA? I'm the only person there for now.
Miguel (Payroll): Short answer: an employee working in a new state can create payroll withholding and unemployment registration requirements for the employer. For a single headcount it usually means payroll registration and withholding, not broader corporate income tax nexus. That said, some states (and localities) have specific filings. I'll flag this to Tax Counsel for confirmation.
Miguel (Payroll): Internal links & steps: https://redwood.internal/hr/homebase-change (internal)
```
Steps to update homebase:
1) Manager approval (reply in thread)
2) Submit homebase change form + proof (lease/util) at: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/homebase-change
3) Payroll processes withholding change (allow 1 pay cycle)
4) Update Benefits portal if needed
5) Submit Badge/Workspace request if hub change
```
Miguel (Payroll): Send docs to payroll@redwood.com if you want us to queue it. If you prefer I can route to tax counsel now — tell me and I'll escalate.
Priya (People Ops): Please escalate — I'd like to be sure before signing lease. Thanks! :pray:
Onboarding Bot: Reminder — changing homebase will trigger a benefits eligibility check and may require a carrier address update. You will receive an email within 48 hours after form submission.
Ava (People Ops): @Miguel can you confirm whether stipend tax treatment changes across states? E.g., is the WFH allowance taxable differently in WA vs OR?
Miguel (Payroll): The stipend is taxable income in payroll; state withholding applies based on employee home state. There may be slight differences in state local taxes but the stipend is processed the same way. We'll include the stipend in the withholding calc after the change.
Priya (People Ops): Ok — I'll get manager sign-off today and upload the lease. I'll reply here when submitted. Thanks all :+1:
